meta.name: Major League Soccer
meta.notice: Fixtures and results come from a free multi-source pipeline. Attack and defense ratings are fitted from 2,305 completed matches using a Bayesian state-space Poisson model. Polymarket values are an independent comparison and appear only when an active matching market is found.

news.headline: Automated model refresh completed
news.summary: The latest Major League Soccer data was downloaded, the Bayesian model was fully refitted, and 20,000 season simulations were completed.

details.validation: Snapshot generated successfully; workflow validation runs before publication.
details.deployment: Published to the live site after both league jobs completed.
details.inference: NumPyro stochastic variational inference with an automatic normal guide
